title: Algerian Sweet Potato Wrap
description: A delicious Algerian-inspired sweet potato wrap with a hint of spice.
instructions: Poke some holes in the sweet potatoes and bake for 45-60 minutes, or until tender.
While the sweet potatoes are baking, mix together cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper in a small bowl.
Once the sweet potatoes are done, let them cool for a few minutes.
Slice the sweet potatoes in half lengthwise and mash with a fork.
Add the spice mixture to the mashed sweet potatoes and mix well.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Warm the flatbread wrap in the oven for a few minutes.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the sweet potato mixture onto the flatbread, then topping with fresh cilantro.
